correctness.rationale: Every length-2m image rotation beginning at a block boundary has balanced one-deck and 01 count m²/2. The exact rotation difference formula for scattered triples, together with constant even-position two-decks, gives a two-letter block transport depending only on block type, with opposite increments for 01 and 10. The Thue–Morse paired-block identity bounds complete triple decks by seven states; 01 and 001 counts separate all seven, and a balanced lower-rank prefix gives exact multiplicities. The finite checker directly recomputes complete decks for all rotations through rank 9 and agrees. No finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The result identifies the exact reconstruction ambiguity of every cyclic starting position of a classical automatic word under its complete length-three scattered-subsequence signature. Seven classes for arbitrarily long iterates, their exact unequal multiplicities, and a two-statistic sufficient signature give more information than global boundedness or all-factor class counts. The class-size profile is an infinite-family structural law, not a finite enumeration or routine reformulation.
